previous_statement: Direct block multiplication gives X_r X_c=E_{11} tensor (X^dagger X). The amplified compressed-product identification in the validated rectangular-product lemma gives X_r dot X_c=Co_{Q_n,Q_n}(X_rX_c)=E_{11} tensor Co_Q(X^dagger X)=E_{11} tensor (X^dagger dot X). Thus both the ambient and compressed products are precisely the square zero-paddings of the original row-column products; in particular the latter lands in the Q-corner, and ||X_r dot X_c-X_rX_c||=||X^dagger dot X-X^dagger X||.
new_statement: For the canonical zero-paddings from 1.3.1.1, direct block multiplication alone gives X_r X_c=E_{11} tensor (X^dagger X). The present shard's allowed inputs do not supply amplification naturality Co_{Q_n,Q_n}(E_{11} tensor Z)=E_{11} tensor Co_Q(Z), nor a square-zero-padding norm isometry. Consequently no identity between X_r dot X_c and E_{11} tensor (X^dagger dot X), and no equality ||X_r dot X_c-X_rX_c||=||X^dagger dot X-X^dagger X||, follows here; those former assertions are withdrawn.
